name: Overflight App
description: A mobile app for managing flight overflight permissions with the authorities of the countries in the route.
objective: Improve the app design and make the logic for managing overflight permissions functional.
participation: Improving the visual interface and user experience of the application.
Fixing critical functionalities such as the process of requesting an overflight order
implementation: Implementing the design decisions in the application to improve the interfaces and user experience, which were not optimized before.
Revising the application logic so that the process of requesting an overflight permit works correctly, using the FlutterFlow processes, such as custom functions in Dart and JavaScript.
Restructuring the application's database, which was disorganized and not scalable, to make it more efficient and easier to maintain.
results: The application has a more attractive design and a smoother user experience without navigation flaws.
The process of requesting overflight permits works correctly: From the payment gateway to the sending of the permit email, and the notification of the Permit Number.
The organized database facilitated data insertion and search, indices and relationships between collections, which improves the performance and scalability of the application.

name: Restaurant Web Hot Punto Multiple del Sabor
description: Website for ordering quick meals for delivery or direct pickup at the restaurant.
objective: Propose a new version of the original website with improvements for home delivery.
participation: Generate a modern and attractive design for the website using v0 (Vercel).
Obtain products and their information through Web Scraping of the original restaurant to display them on the new website.
Implement a customization system for additional options for quick meal products, specifically for some pizzas that are to the customer's taste
Implement shipping methods according to the customer's location, the restaurant's location, and the availability of deliveries.
implementation: Several design proposals were presented for the website thanks to the v0 tool, and the one that best adapted to the client's needs was chosen. From there, sections were modified to add banners, buttons, menus and alternative pages for the needs of the restaurant website.
Through a Python script that allowed extracting information from the original restaurant's products and storing it in an initial JSON file.

Through the JSON obtained from the web scraping, the logic was implemented so that customers can customize their orders: Quantity, additional options according to the product and additional notes from the customer.

A delivery system was implemented: Go to the sales point or by home delivery. In both cases, it is required to have all sales points through their geographic coordinates stored in a GeoJSON file, adding their opening and closing hours, so that the customer can choose the closest sales point to their location and that it is open at the time of purchase.
results: Several design proposals were presented for the website thanks to the v0 tool, and the one that best adapted to the client's needs was chosen.
The client agreed with the way the client chooses the products and customizes them for the order.
The client tested the delivery system through the map and tested the different ways the client interacts with the website to place an order for quick meals.

image.alt: Section of product categories for Hot Punto Multiple del Sabor.

name: SI-18 Admin Panel
description: A three-module dashboard for the Transmilenio mass transit operator, SI-18.
objective: Implement the admin panel from the frontend perspective, consisting of three modules: Scheduling, Accounting and Purchasing.
participation: I was directly responsible for creating the modules, components and functionalities of the project, with assisted help from AI.
Connecting with the API that the backend team sent to obtain data.
Participation in planning meetings, progress tracking and delivery of results.
implementation: I used React and Tailwind for the frontend development, with reusable components and statistical charts in each section of the dashboard.
I connected to the backend API to fetch data and display it in the dashboard within its respective modules represented in values, charts, tables and documents.
I implemented authentication logic based on roles, route protection, error handling and data loading states.
results: The implementation of the dashboard improved the efficiency in data visualization, which was previously difficult to visualize only in a database.
Positive feedback was obtained from the end users intended to use it.
A improvement in the user experience was achieved by providing easier access to critical information.

image.alt: Dashboard administrativo responsive con tablas y tarjetas de métricas

name: Droguerias Farmavida
description: E-commerce for the sale of pharmaceutical and personal care products operating in Colombia.
objective: Improve the user experience and attention on the website.
participation: Had full access to the WordPress administrator, databases and hosting for management.
Access to the n8n node flow responsible for process automation such as a chatbot that suggests products to customers.
Possibility to modify products and prices of the e-commerce both through WordPress and through massive import files.
implementation: Adjusted the language of the texts in the shopping and products section of the website, which some were in English due to the installed theme.
Configured an n8n node for customer service through a chatbot to suggest products based on the user's needs.
Created a backup of WordPress, as the hosting had crashed and access to the website was lost, but it was possible to restore and recover the information from the database and files of the website.
Fixed a problem when making a purchase from the website that made customers unsure if the purchase was completed correctly, as they were not receiving a confirmation email.
Modified the price and status of some products according to the client's needs.
results: The user experience was improved by adjusting the language of the texts in the website.
The chatbot was tested between the team and the brand owner to launch to the public.
Lost information was recovered after the hosting failure.

image.alt: Homepage of the Droguerías Farmavida website showing products and categories.

name: Hoteles ByHours Website
description: Website for selling hourly room bookings from a hotel chain operating in Barranquilla and Bogotá (Colombia).
objective: Create and configure the website for selling hourly room bookings.
participation: Responsibility of creating the website from scratch, with the design proposed by the design team and the configuration of the necessary plugins for its operation.
implementation: Initialized and configured WordPress with the theme proposed by the design team, and the necessary plugins for building the website.
Created the booking form natively (HTML, CSS, JavaScript through custom snippets) that leads users to a WhatsApp chat to complete the room reservation.
Created the respective pages for each hotel according to the content established by the marketing team; displaying information about each one, such as photos, services, location and prices.
Added multilingual support (English and Spanish) and SEO tracking metrics to improve the website's visibility.
results: The visual expectations of the client regarding colors, texts and content presented on the website were met.
The functionality of the booking form was successful both on the web and responsive, leading users to the WhatsApp chat with the room reservation parameters.
